question: After the code blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw maintainers/secops authorize this exact-head xAI plugin dependency graph change and bundled xAI realtime voice provider surface?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes runtime dependency ownership and adds a provider feature/config surface; automation can repair the code sequencing bugs, but it cannot approve dependency graph policy or product acceptance.

options.title: Fix blockers, then approve exact head
options.body: Repair the reconnect text queue and playback sequencing defects first, then have a maintainer/secops owner approve the `ws` runtime dependency move for the reviewed head if the bundled provider direction is accepted.

options.title: Hold for maintainer-owned dependency regeneration
options.body: Keep the PR open but require maintainers to regenerate or carry the dependency graph change internally before merge.

options.title: Pause bundled provider direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want xAI realtime voice to remain outside bundled OpenClaw core for now.

recommendation.title: Fix blockers, then approve exact head
recommendation.body: Repair the reconnect text queue and playback sequencing defects first, then have a maintainer/secops owner approve the `ws` runtime dependency move for the reviewed head if the bundled provider direction is accepted.
